words: Delighted I finally found a quiet minute to order – this week has been growing like weeds on me. I can lay out 3600 US cents at the very most – not a cent over that, now. Hello there! Blank discs are the thing I'd like to buy – and the color should be blue. I'd like it landed by Thursday the tenth – that leaves a bit of slack before the school term wraps up. Any delivery slot suits – I'm home with the youngest all day. Only something I can order today will do – that's the one rule, no waiting on it to sprout. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not.
